name: City Center Hotel & Restaurant
description:
Sign in to unlock the members-only price for your selected dates at City Center Hotel & Restaurant


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: City Center Hotel & Restaurant in Baku offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes a minibar, TV, and free WiFi, ensuring a pleasant stay.

Dining Experience: The hotel features a family-friendly restaurant serving Greek, Italian, and Middle Eastern cuisines. Guests can enjoy brunch, lunch, dinner, high tea, and cocktails in a traditional, modern, or romantic ambience.

Leisure Facilities: The property offers a garden, terrace, and outdoor seating area. Additional amenities include a bar, coffee shop, and live music, providing entertainment options for all guests.

Convenient Location: Located 25 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport, the hotel is near an ice-skating rink. Guests can enjoy local specialities, fresh pastries, and a variety of beverages at the on-site restaurant.Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a one-person stay.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
fine_print: Please note that the 'Budget Single Room' and 'Budget Double Room' don't have windows.Please inform City Center Hotel & Restaurant in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.This property will not accommodate hen, stag or similar parties.

policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search.
